module.name: Drift_Taxonomy
module.summary: A universal taxonomy for identifying, classifying, and correcting regime drift in gravitational physics.
module.purpose: Provide a structured system for capturing drift types, classifying literature, deriving minimal algebraic corrections, and assembling a unified meta-paper.
module.audience: Researchers, physicists, mathematicians, and contributors preparing the unified drift-correction paper.

roles.engine: Defines the drift taxonomy and operator families used to regularize gravitational anomalies.
roles.profile: Describes drift types and their signatures across classical, quantum, and cosmological regimes.
roles.signature: Minimal algebraic operator corrections applicable across all drift categories.
roles.diagnostic: Classification templates for evaluating ~200 gravity papers.
roles.map: Representative examples demonstrating corrections on ten canonical works.
roles.example: Worked corrections applied to selected papers.
roles.extension: Future drift types or operator families may be added as the corpus expands.
roles.index: README.md provides the directory overview and workflow.
roles.reference: d_Source.md contains source lists and citation anchors.
roles.template: Classification and operator templates for contributors.
